key_headlines.title: Government Implements Third Oil Price Cap from April 10, Launches Comprehensive Inflation Control Task Force
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-chul announced the third oil price ceiling effective from April 10 at midnight, alongside a comprehensive price stabilization measure including 5 trillion won supplementary budget allocation for oil cost reduction and various consumer relief programs.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea Expected to Hold Rates Steady for Seventh Consecutive Meeting Amid Inflation and Exchange Rate Concerns
key_headlines.summary: The Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Committee is expected to maintain the base rate at 2.5% for the seventh consecutive time on April 10, as Governor Lee Chang-yong faces inflation pressures from Middle East conflicts and currency volatility in his final rate decision.

key_headlines.title: US Federal Reserve Discusses Both Rate Hike and Cut Possibilities Due to Middle East War Inflation Concerns
key_headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve's March FOMC minutes revealed that committee members discussed both interest rate increase and decrease possibilities, reflecting heightened uncertainty from Middle East conflict-driven energy price increases.

key_headlines.title: SK On Battery Secures 67% of Hyundai Electric Vehicle Market, Signaling Performance Improvement
key_headlines.summary: SK On's batteries are equipped in 67% of Hyundai electric vehicles as of February 2026, benefiting from increased EV preference driven by early subsidy implementation and high oil prices, providing positive signals for improved earnings.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Prices Show Moderated Growth; Multi-Property Owners Await Tax Deadline in Bargaining Standoff
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment prices showed a weekly appreciation of 0.10% as of early April, with outer districts gaining momentum while Gangnam areas experienced decline, while multi-property owners and buyers engage in price negotiations ahead of capital gains tax surcharge deadline.

sections.Hot Economy News: The South Korean government launched a comprehensive inflation control campaign with Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-chul announcing the third oil price ceiling effective April 10 and a 5 trillion won supplementary budget. The initiative targets multiple consumer pain points including telecommunications costs (targeting 380 billion won savings), PC support for low-income households, private academy tuition monitoring, and food supply stabilization through government reserves of pollock and mackerel. The government is simultaneously releasing government-stockpiled cod from April 13 through June 30 and diversifying mackerel imports while offering up to 40% chicken discounts and releasing 1,800 tons of government garlic reserves.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Committee is widely expected to maintain the base rate at 2.5% for the seventh consecutive meeting on April 10, as inflation and exchange rate volatility persist amid Middle East conflict concerns. Governor Lee Chang-yong's final rate decision comes amid conflicting pressures: stagflation risks from war-driven energy prices and economic growth slowdown indicators. The OECD recently revised South Korea's 2026 real GDP growth forecast downward to reflect geopolitical uncertainties. Meanwhile, the US Federal Reserve's March FOMC minutes revealed that members discussed both rate increase and decrease possibilities, indicating heightened policy uncertainty from Middle East-driven energy inflation and employment concerns.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI declined 0.6% to the 5,830 level in early trading while KOSDAQ showed gains, as the Fed's March FOMC minutes confirming continued rate hold had limited market impact. Foreign investor selling pressure amid Middle East tensions continued to weigh on Korean equities, with the newly-launched KOSDAQ Active ETF experiencing sharp losses just one month after its debut. Market attention focused on potential ceasefire developments and upcoming US CPI data as critical drivers for rate cut expectations, while major US tech stocks showed mixed performance with Amazon surging 5.6% and other mega-cap stocks diverging sharply.
sections.Industry & Technology: SK On's battery dominance in Hyundai electric vehicles, capturing 67% market share as of February 2026, showed performance improvement signals as EV demand strengthened from early subsidy implementation and high oil prices creating favorable conditions. The Korean battery industry faces significant challenges including severe Chinese dumping pressures on polysilicon, steel, chemicals, and battery products, with competitors undercutting prices by over 15%. The sector also grapples with power grid flexibility requirements for AI and renewable energy transition, necessitating coordinated deployment of pumped hydro, demand response resources, battery ESS, and nuclear power generation adjustment mechanisms.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices moderated with a 0.10% weekly appreciation rate in early April, down from 0.12% the previous week, as outer districts maintained upward momentum while Gangnam areas continued declining. Multi-property owners and buyers engaged in price negotiations as the capital gains tax surcharge expiration deadline approached in mid-May, creating a cautious market atmosphere with extended standoffs. Gangnam full prices declined while jeonse (long-term lease) prices also shifted to decline mode, and the Aero de Seocho luxury unit in Seocho-dong achieved record high competition rates with two units allocated to perfect credit scoring bidders of 84 points.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve's March FOMC minutes revealed heightened concerns about Middle East conflict-driven energy inflation potentially forcing rate increases despite economic slowdown risks, with some members emphasizing both rate hike and cut possibilities. A two-week ceasefire agreement between the US and Iran began April 11 with peace negotiations scheduled in Pakistan, though market participants expressed skepticism about resolution within the timeframe. US-China semiconductor competition escalated with legal and regulatory measures creating potential supply chain disruptions, while American economic growth decelerated with fourth-quarter GDP expanding only 0.5%, intensifying Fed policy uncertainty regarding inflation and employment trends.
sections.AI & Economy: Goldman Sachs research indicated AI labor displacement could increase unemployment by up to 0.5 percentage points over the next decade, with workers transitioning to new jobs experiencing 10 percentage point wage reductions. The government accelerated AI integration into public sector operations, with the Science and Technology Ministry launching the AI-NEXT initiative and the Finance Ministry investing 226 billion won in the AI-ONE platform construction project. Premium AI notebooks featuring on-device AI processing without cloud connectivity emerged as new PC market opportunities, exemplified by LG's Gram Pro AI 2026 maintaining the series' lightweight identity at 1.19kg while enabling efficient AI execution.
sections.Others: Kia announced approximately 49 trillion won investment over five years through 2029 toward autonomous driving technology achieving Level 2++ capability by partnering with global leaders including Nvidia and Google DeepMind, with humanoid robots Atlas deployable in US factories by late 2029. GS Construction signed a memorandum of understanding with Hana Financial Group subsidiaries to expand investment in advanced strategic industries including data centers and digital infrastructure through collaborative financing and project financing mechanisms. President Lee met with the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions for policy discussions on labor rights guarantees, while pre-ceasefire betting activity on prediction markets involving newly-created accounts raised transparency concerns about information leakage before the US-Iran ceasefire announcement.
